description: Instrumentation test class for the Home screen of the Fitness TV frontend app, testing UI rendering, focus navigation, and activity launching via Espresso.

classes.name: HomeFlowTest
classes.description: JUnit test class for verifying Home Screen UI and interactions in the fitness app.

methods.name: setup
methods.description: Initializes preferences and launches MainActivity with Espresso Intents for testing.

methods.name: tearDown
methods.description: Releases Espresso Intents after test execution.

methods.name: homeRendersRailsAndHeader
methods.description: Verifies that core UI components like container and title are visible.

methods.name: dpadFocusMovesBetweenElements
methods.description: Simulates DPAD navigation via arrow keys to ensure UI remains stable during focus moves.

methods.name: clickWorkoutCard_launchesPlayerActivity
methods.description: Attempts to click on workout content and verifies that PlayerActivity is launched.
